visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a cozy interior space of a cafe named 'ease'. Customers are seen browsing in the background near a counter filled with greenery. (2) The camera pans across the interior, showing shelves stocked with various jars and products. A staff member is visible behind the counter. The atmosphere is warm with natural light coming through large windows, and the space is decorated with lush indoor plants. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor table where a vibrant spread of desserts is presented. There's a slice of strawberry cream cake, a tart topped with an orange slice, a cup of coffee, and an iced tea. The setting is bright and sunny. (4) Close-up shots feature various exquisite pastries inside a glass display case. Each item is meticulously crafted, including a layered chocolate mousse cake and individual tarts. Small price cards in Japanese are placed in front of each item. (5) A close-up shows a hand drizzling brown syrup over a slice of strawberry cake. The cake has clear layers of sponge, cream, and fresh strawberry halves. The action highlights the texture and freshness of the dessert. (6) A woman with dark hair tied back is shown seated outdoors, enjoying a dessert. She takes a bite of the orange-topped tart, smiles with squinted eyes, and nods appreciatively. She is wearing a dark coat over a grey sweater. (7) The video transitions back indoors, focusing on a long shelf filled with packaged goods and loose pastries like madeleines on white plates. Tongs are placed nearby for customers. Large windows show a street view in the background. (8) Close-up shots showcase the elegant packaging of the gift boxes, which are deep green with intricate patterns. Cookies are displayed in clear cylindrical containers. The lighting is bright, emphasizing the quality and texture of the products.
